about: Two switches after one move, in play: a Red Card and an Eject Button both answer one move, the card first -- the card's Pokemon comes in before the button's (Pokemon Central, Pulsantefuga) -- battle_controller_player.c's post-move step that walks the cards, then the buttons. Twins Amy & Mimi in the Azalea Gym against a scratch copy of Paolo's Bugsy save, a level-30 Pawmot, Magikarp and Snorlax put on the twins' platform: the Spinarak is given a Red Card, the Ledyba an Eject Button, both only Splash; the Pawmot's Twister hits the two, the Spinarak's card drags the Pawmot out for the Snorlax, and then the Ledyba goes back with its button.

lines: Spinarak held up its Red Card against Pawmot!
Ledyba is switched out with the Eject Button!
